title: Copilot Studio: cost controls in the Microsoft 365 admin center
summary: The briefing passes: Microsoft documents the opt-in transition, replacement of covered Power Platform controls, billing arrangements and administrative permissions. Minor clarifications remain about app runtime scope and differing navigation labels within Microsoft's policy instructions.

claims.claim: Copilot Studio environments and agents can be managed through Microsoft 365 admin center spending policies.
claims.quote: Manage Copilot Studio spending in the Microsoft 365 admin center by creating policies for environments or individual agents.

claims.claim: Covered resources stop using their linked Power Platform billing plans.
claims.quote: Existing Power Platform capacity allocations and linked billing plans don't apply while spending for that environment is managed by a resource-based spending policy in the Microsoft 365 admin center.

claims.claim: Removing an environment from a resource policy automatically resumes its applicable Power Platform policy.
claims.quote: If you remove an environment from a spending policy or delete the resource-based spending policy, the applicable Power Platform admin center policy resumes for that environment automatically.

claims.claim: Deleting the resource policy automatically resumes the applicable Power Platform policy.
claims.quote: The same fallback applies when you delete the Microsoft 365 admin center resource-based spending policy that covered it; no additional Power Platform setup is required.

claims.claim: Administrators should allow up to 12 minutes after linking an environment for the policy to apply.
claims.quote: After you link an environment to a Microsoft 365 spending policy, allow up to 12 minutes for the new policy to apply.

claims.claim: Capacity overages > Draw from the available capacity in my tenant controls drawing unallocated prepaid tenant capacity.

claims.claim: Capacity overages > Bill to my pay-as-you-go billing plan controls continuing usage through a selected billing plan.

claims.claim: An agent's monthly limit is reached through Licensing > Products > Copilot Studio > Summary > Manage Agents > agent > Set limit in the Power Platform admin center.

In the Power Platform admin center, go to **Licensing** > **Copilot Studio**.
2. Select **Manage Agents**.
3. Select the agent, and then select **Set limit**.

claims.claim: Power Platform agent limits are not applied instantly.
claims.quote: Limits aren't applied instantly. An agent can continue to respond for some time after it reaches its limit, so set limits and notification thresholds with some margin.

claims.claim: No Copilot Studio-specific monthly per-agent limit API is documented in the cited references.
